founders.name: Michael Mounajjed
education: Rice University, dropped out (CS and Applied Math)
previous_startups: Calceus Mining (Ethereum rigs, founded in high school)
founders.background_notes: Parents are physicians per the YC page.

founders.name: Benjamin Liu
founders.background_notes: President of Rice's largest software engineering group per the YC page.

competitors.name: Amion
competitors.what: Physician scheduling widely used in emergency medicine
competitors.traction_then: Ranked top for automation accuracy in KLAS reports

technical_complexity.rationale: Constraint scheduling plus EHR and payroll integrations is standard engineering with hard optimization parts.

defensibility.rationale: Scheduling data and integrations create switching costs and enterprise compliance (SOC 2 Type II claimed).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents persisted; QGenda owns ShiftAdmin; none was found copying or buying Durate.

market_need_then: Hospitals face coverage gaps and clinician burnout and rely on dated schedulers; the company started inside a psychiatry residency scheduling problem.

identity.voice_and_tone: Software built with the provider at heart

rebrands.why: Not stated; the YC page says it was previously named Docflow, and a Docflow Labs trademark was filed 2024-11-27.

brand_strength.rationale: Sources show only company marketing and a QGenda alternatives blog post; no independent press about the brand.

pivots.from: Docflow, started at Harvard's psychiatry residency program
pivots.to: Durate, physician scheduling for groups, clinics and hospitals
pivots.why: Rename and wider scope per the YC page; reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Durate began as Docflow inside a psychiatry residency and now lists customers such as Brown Emergency Medicine across seven hospitals, Baylor College of Medicine and Cambridge Health Alliance. No funding or exit evidence was found. Entrenched incumbents are the main risk, while hospital customer logos suggest early enterprise traction.
notes: The shard website durate.ai did not resolve; fetched durate.com instead. Funding unverified: FundedIQ reports $500K pre-seed in 2024-12, no primary source, so not a round. Competitors QGenda and Amion are from a 2023 KLAS ranking found in search; the page was not opened, so traction_then comes from the snippet. Name origin not found.
